formal_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide ((Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n => x i = true).card % 2 = 1)) (4 * (n - 1))
plain_statement: The parity of n inputs has a fan-in 2 circuit of AND, OR, NOT gates with 4(n - 1) gates: each exclusive or is (a or b) and not (a and b). Folklore. With the 3(n - 1) lower bound this brackets the exact size in a basis that counts NOT gates.
title: Parity of n inputs has a circuit with 4(n - 1) gates
